svg.title: Argo control plane: split hosting and the write path
svg.desc: Argo control plane: browser, VPS half (SPA, life API, dead-man receiver, PWA push), mini half (factory read API, ledger, effector, heartbeat), MacBook observer and actuator, and the write path from verb to intent, executor, audit event and end state.

g.title: Browser · MacBook · phone, on the tailnet · Architecture component · phone: Home-Screen PWA

PWA web push · sent from the VPS half · VPS · always up
Dead-man receiver · mini + homelab, push at 15 min · VPS · always up
Homelab · 5-min heartbeat · Architecture component
Effector · push deliveries, at-least-once · mini
Heartbeat · 5 min · egress probe · mini
Factory read API · ledger only · each as_of · mini
Ledger + event log · herdr, quota, usage arrive as events · mini
